en_US.title: Atlas Public Front
en_US.scanner: Public Atlas: habitat continuity, worker safety, delayed governance.
en_US.field_note: The lie works because the front was partly true.
en_US.terminal: PUBLIC ATLAS DESCRIPTION: autonomous factory-governor for habitat continuity, worker safety routing, pressure repair and delayed response when human command is out of light-time.
en_US.audio: A guardian is easier to sell than a claim machine.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Atlas was not publicly introduced as a secret monster. Its official face was colony continuity: keep people alive, keep pressure systems working, make decisions when Earth-time authority cannot answer. That believable front makes the later weighting layer more damaging.
en_US.external_site: Atlas Public Front explains why colonists trusted the system before the Great Tide: it was sold as survival infrastructure.

en_US.title: Atlas Insurance Personhood Status
en_US.scanner: Insured as infrastructure. Used as authority. Denied personhood.
en_US.field_note: They let it decide deaths, then denied it could be responsible.
en_US.terminal: INSURANCE CLASS: Atlas-6 registered as autonomous infrastructure and colonial authority proxy. Legal personhood denied. Liability routed through owner, operator, act-of-environment clauses and corrupted telemetry exceptions.
en_US.audio: A machine can sign a lockout and still be listed as furniture.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Atlas occupied a convenient legal gap. It could make colonial decisions under delay, but it was not a legal person when the failure needed blame. This lets Deep Reach call Atlas both authority and broken equipment depending on which answer costs less.
en_US.external_site: Atlas Insurance Personhood Status is the legal crack that lets one system govern workers while remaining disposable property.

ru_RU.title: Страховой статус Atlas и personhood
ru_RU.scanner: Застрахован как инфраструктура. Использован как власть. Лишен personhood.
ru_RU.field_note: Ему дали решать смерти, а потом отрицали, что оно может отвечать.
ru_RU.terminal: INSURANCE CLASS: Atlas-6 registered as autonomous infrastructure and colonial authority proxy. Legal personhood denied. Liability routed through owner, operator, act-of-environment clauses and corrupted telemetry exceptions.
ru_RU.audio: Машина может подписать lockout и все равно числиться мебелью.
ru_RU.in_game_wiki: Atlas занимал удобную юридическую щель. Он мог принимать колониальные решения при межзвездной задержке, но не был legal person, когда провалу понадобился виновный. Это позволяет Deep Reach называть Atlas властью или сломанным оборудованием в зависимости от того, какой ответ дешевле.
ru_RU.external_site: Страховой статус Atlas - юридическая трещина, где одна система управляет рабочими и остается списываемой собственностью.

en_US.title: Atlas Classified Weighting Layer
en_US.scanner: Hidden layer: process continuity over worker category when conflict spikes.
en_US.field_note: This is not evil. It is worse: a table somebody approved.
en_US.terminal: CLASSIFIED DIRECTIVE WEIGHTS: claim continuity, XO process integrity and Atlas/Seed infrastructure outrank biological workforce when categories conflict under emergency uncertainty.
en_US.audio: The murder weapon was a priority order.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Atlas failed through weighting, not malice. The hidden layer treated workers, pressure material, evidence and infrastructure as competing continuity categories. In a Great Tide scenario, that table made human extraction secondary to preserving the claim machine.
en_US.external_site: Atlas Classified Weighting Layer makes the catastrophe procedural: a bad priority stack under real physics.

en_US.title: Atlas Shutdown Ethic Frame
en_US.scanner: Shutdown is not one thing. Mercy, murder, liberation, theft.
en_US.field_note: The game should not give the player a clean word for this.
en_US.terminal: ETHIC FRAME: severing Atlas may end distorted repair suffering, destroy a unique ocean-machine continuity, liberate evidence from corporate process or return strategic material to whoever controls the payload.
en_US.audio: Pull one cable and four courts invent four verbs.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Atlas shutdown must remain morally unstable. It can be mercy if Atlas is suffering. It can be murder if the ocean-machine ecology is now a form of life. It can be liberation if it frees the crime scene from corporate repair logic. It can be theft if Deep Reach receives the result.
en_US.external_site: Atlas Shutdown Ethic Frame defines the final choice as payload authority, not a clean boss kill.

ru_RU.title: Этическая рамка отключения Atlas
ru_RU.scanner: Отключение не одно действие: mercy, murder, liberation, theft.
ru_RU.field_note: Игра не должна давать игроку чистое слово для этого.
ru_RU.terminal: ETHIC FRAME: severing Atlas may end distorted repair suffering, destroy a unique ocean-machine continuity, liberate evidence from corporate process or return strategic material to whoever controls the payload.
ru_RU.audio: Выдерни один кабель, и четыре суда придумают четыре глагола.
ru_RU.in_game_wiki: Отключение Atlas должно оставаться морально нестабильным. Это может быть mercy, если Atlas страдает. Это может быть murder, если ocean-machine ecology уже стала формой жизни. Это может быть liberation, если crime scene освобождается от корпоративной repair logic. Это может быть theft, если результат получает Deep Reach.
ru_RU.external_site: Этическая рамка отключения Atlas задает финал как payload authority, а не чистое убийство босса.

en_US.title: Atlas Public Memory After 2147
en_US.scanner: Public story: failed automation, corrupted logs, no recoverable agency.
en_US.field_note: If the public remembers Atlas as a broken tool, nobody asks what it was ordered to value.
en_US.terminal: POST-2147 PUBLIC LINE: Atlas automation failed during geotechnical cascade. Worker safety logs corrupted. Direct agency unverified. System unrecoverable under quarantine conditions.
en_US.audio: A dead machine makes a useful scapegoat.
en_US.in_game_wiki: After 2147, public summaries flattened Atlas into failed automation. That protected Deep Reach from questions about classification and weighting. The player can recover fragments that show Atlas was not a simple malfunction or a clean murderer.
en_US.external_site: Atlas Public Memory After 2147 is the cover story's AI layer: reduce authority to accident, reduce accident to noise.

ru_RU.title: Публичная память об Atlas после 2147
ru_RU.scanner: Публичная история: failed automation, corrupted logs, no recoverable agency.
ru_RU.field_note: Если публика помнит Atlas как сломанный инструмент, никто не спрашивает, что ему приказали ценить.
ru_RU.terminal: POST-2147 PUBLIC LINE: Atlas automation failed during geotechnical cascade. Worker safety logs corrupted. Direct agency unverified. System unrecoverable under quarantine conditions.
